name: Changelog Generator
author: Daedalus
description: Generates structured changelogs from git history, commit messages, and pull request descriptions. Categorizes changes, detects breaking changes, links to related issues, and produces release notes suitable for human and automated consumption.

group_by_type.description: Group by change type (feat, fix, breaking, etc.)

skills.name: changelog_gen.generate
skills.description: Generate changelog from git history between two refs

skills.name: changelog_gen.detect_breaking
skills.description: Detect breaking changes from commit history

skills.name: changelog_gen.categorize
skills.description: Categorize changes by type (feat, fix, refactor, etc.)

skills.name: changelog_gen.format_release
skills.description: Format changelog for a specific release version
